name: Shield Wall [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You form a unified defense with those around you.

Prerequisite(s): Shield Proficiency.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are wielding a shield and are adjacent to an ally wielding a shield, the AC bonus from your ally’s shield increases, depending on the shield you are wielding. If you are wielding a buckler or a light shield, their shield bonus increases by +1. If you are wielding a heavy shield or a tower shield, their shield bonus increases by +2. Your ally keeps these bonuses even if you lose your shield bonus due to making a shield bash attack. If you use a tower shield to grant total cover, your ally also benefits if an attack targeting them passes through the edge of the shield.
